name: alternating-bit
title: Alternating bit protocol, one frame in flight
source: Protocol of K. A. Bartlett, R. A. Scantlebury, P. T. Wilkinson, "A note on reliable full-duplex transmission over half-duplex links", CACM 12(5), 1969. Boolean encoding written for this zoo; acknowledgement is collapsed into the delivery step.
note: The broken sender stamps the frame with the complement of its own sequence bit, so the channel carries a frame that no longer matches the sender.
